title: Embedded media
description: Discover embedded audio/video and archive direct files or HLS/DASH manifests, selected segments, initialization data, captions and ordinary AES-128 keys into one WACZ.

MEDIA_FETCH_MISSING.description: Fetch discovered direct media and stream dependencies; live, protected, unsupported or truncated captures are explicitly partial.

MEDIA_MAX_MB.description: Budget for inspected original media bodies; an oversized response is cancelled rather than saved as a corrupt complete file.
